catalogueDecisions.status: Owner-directed artwork catalogue; no wire IDs or encoders changed
catalogueDecisions.default_rule: Original (review) is a source-color preset, not a ninth color. It resolves to the contextual authored palette entry. Selecting that entry retains the original fabric/hair material variation rather than flattening it to one HEX.
catalogueDecisions.brown: Brown uses authored brown materials; the redundant darker-brown review treatment is retired with261.
catalogueDecisions.lens_rule: Dark by default except Reading clear; alternative lens preview and lash hiding are review controls, not new profile bits.
